description: This file defines an internal interface for stream providers within the Orleans framework, including methods to obtain producer and consumer interfaces for streaming data.

classes.name: IInternalStreamProvider
classes.description: An internal interface for stream providers that provides methods to access producer and consumer interfaces for streams.

methods.name: GetProducerInterface
methods.description: Returns an internal async batch observer for the provided stream.

methods.name: GetConsumerInterface
methods.description: Returns an internal async observable for the provided stream.
